categories.title: Starters & Appetizers

items.name: Hummus
items.desc: A silky dip of garbanzo beans with garlic, tahini, olive oil, and lemon juice. Served with pita bread.
items.alt: Bowl of hummus with olive oil and whole chickpeas, pita on the side

items.name: Baba Ganoush
items.desc: Charbroiled eggplant dip with fresh herbs, tahini, yogurt, olive oil, and lemon juice. Served with pita bread.
items.alt: Smoky eggplant dip drizzled with olive oil, pita on the side

items.name: Cacikli (Tzatziki)
items.desc: Yogurt with shredded cucumber, fresh diced dill, and a hint of garlic. Served with pita bread.
items.alt: Bowl of yogurt and cucumber dip topped with dill, pita on the side

items.name: Shakshuka
items.desc: A Mediterranean appetizer of tomatoes, peppers, and eggplant. Served with pita bread.
items.alt: Bowl of stewed tomatoes, peppers and eggplant, pita on the side

items.name: Dolmas
items.desc: Tender vine leaves rolled with rice, pine nuts, onion, currants, and fresh herbs. Served with pita bread.
items.alt: Four stuffed vine leaves on a plate with pita

items.name: Falafel
items.desc: Chickpea falafel, pan-fried and served with a side of hummus, with tahini sauce on top.
items.alt: Falafel drizzled with tahini beside a bowl of hummus

items.name: Appetizers Combo
items.desc: A mezze platter of traditional Mediterranean meze: hummus, tzatziki, baba ganoush, shakshuka, dolmas, and falafel. Served with pita bread.
items.alt: Mezze platter with hummus, tzatziki, baba ganoush, shakshuka, dolmas, falafel and pita

categories.intro: Most are served with warm pita bread.

items.name: Lentil Soup
items.desc: Red lentils simmered with potatoes and carrots, served with fresh pita.
items.alt: Bowl of golden lentil soup with fresh pita

items.name: Greek Salad
items.desc: Lettuce with cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, and olives, tossed in a homemade dressing and topped with feta cheese.
items.alt: Greek salad with feta cubes, olives, tomatoes and cucumber

items.name: Beet Salad
items.desc: Fresh beets with baby arugula, cherry tomatoes, and red onions, tossed in a pomegranate dressing.
items.alt: Beet salad with arugula, cherry tomatoes, red onion and pomegranate

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.desc: Chopped romaine lettuce, croutons, and parmesan cheese with a classic Caesar dressing.
items.alt: Caesar salad with romaine, croutons and shaved parmesan

addon.name: Add Chicken or Beef
addon.desc: Add grilled chicken or beef to any salad.

categories.title: Wraps

items.name: Lamb and Beef Gyro Wrap
items.desc: Slow-cooked, thinly sliced, marinated lamb and beef with lettuce, tomato, onion, and tahini sauce, all wrapped in lavash bread.
items.alt: Lavash wrap filled with sliced lamb and beef gyro and vegetables

items.name: Chicken Wrap
items.desc: Marinated grilled chicken with lettuce, tomato, onion, and tahini sauce, all wrapped in lavash bread.
items.alt: Lavash wrap filled with grilled chicken and vegetables

items.name: Falafel Wrap
items.desc: Flavorful falafel with lettuce, pickle, tomato, onion, creamy hummus, and tahini, all wrapped in lavash bread.
items.alt: Lavash wrap filled with falafel, hummus and vegetables

items.name: Adana Kebab Wrap
items.desc: Specially seasoned and marinated ground beef, grilled with Mediterranean spices, with lettuce, tomato, and onion, all wrapped in lavash bread.
items.alt: Lavash wrap filled with an Adana kebab skewer and vegetables

categories.intro: Every wrap is rolled in lavash bread.
